title: Working with Red Allen and a band in Mexico
summary: When Red Allen needed a band, Vincent assembled one with George Lewis and others and went to Mexico, where dance halls got rowdy.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: He ought to know Lucci, because Lucci used to work with Red Allen.
He was all left here when Red Allen started coming out. Yeah.
Tell him Lucci used to work with Red Allen.

He said Lucci used to work with Red Allen. Who? Lucci. Lucci? Lucci, Lucci. Lucci. How about Jackson? Well, Mary said, you know, when I worked with Red Allen, he had just a rockin' band, you know? And I told him if he wanted me, I'd pick him up with a band. And he told me, all right. He said, sometimes he was using some of them fellas over the river, like Yank and Harrison. You know, like they wanted to get it, and Bitsa Vai. He said, you and all them fellas, and me and George Louis. So me and George got together and just made up a band. You know, we had the best of their band around there. So I went to Mexico, you know. There were people out there, and we had a passion jam everywhere we played. We used to get pulled a whole lot of time, too. But they just let us out, you know. They wouldn't probably shoot the pistol in there, shoot the bird out there, but it was everybody, you know.
